import socket,sys,time,json
import arena

def analyze(b,seconds=60,searchmoves=None):
 s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
 def send(x):s.sendall((x+'\n').encode())
 send('uci')
 for l in f:
  if l.strip()=='uciok':break
 send('setoption name Threads value 2');send('setoption name Hash value 256');send('isready')
 for l in f:
  if l.strip()=='readyok':break
 send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
 cmd='go movetime '+str(int(seconds*1000))
 if searchmoves:cmd+=' searchmoves '+' '.join(searchmoves)
 send(cmd)
 latest=''
 for l in f:
  l=l.strip()
  if l.startswith('info depth'):latest=l
  if l.startswith('bestmove'):
   print(latest,flush=True);print(l,flush=True)
   send('quit');s.close();return l.split()[1],latest
if __name__=='__main__':
 b=arena.load_board();move,info=analyze(b,float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 60,sys.argv[2:] or None)
 with open('/workdir/analysis.json','w') as f:json.dump({'fen':b.fen(),'move':move,'info':info},f)
